Workflow.Name: Northwind - Publish reviewed response to portal
Workflow.Description: Staff-only draft-body publication: snapshot HTML and version, convert to plain text, request assigned staff approval, recheck draft/case/recipient, then publish once. No pasted response input and no customer email sending.
